name: 意图乱流 Intent Chaos
author: DSSYAI
description:
怪物受到玩家的直接攻击并真实掉血后，意图立刻从它状态机的全部招式池（含一次性开场招）随机换成另一个招。遗物/能力牌/回合结束等被动伤害不触发。特例：女王前三招固定；本体脚本类招式（亡语自爆、空白意图、必须执行一次的复活/重生招）双向固定，随机不到也换不走，所以瀑布巨兽不会卡无限血、千足虫不会顶着一个什么都不做的空意图、沙虫第一回合的吞噬倒计时既不会被换走也不会重复发动；boss 的招式池里额外有一招"塞诅咒牌"（永久进卡组，寄生式）。
Monsters that lose HP to direct player attack damage reroll their intent to a random different move from their entire move pool (including one-shot openers). Relic/power/end-of-turn passive damage doesn't trigger. Queen keeps her first three moves fixed; scripted moves (death blow / self-destruct, blank hidden intents, must-perform revive states) are pinned both ways, so self-destruct bosses still die and split limbs never sit on a do-nothing blank intent, and the sandworm boss keeps its turn-1 devour timer (it is never rerolled away and never fires twice). Bosses gain a curse-card move that permanently adds a curse to your deck.
